capabilities: Chat with an AI model about your vault from a sidebar or full-screen mobile panel
Let the model search the vault and open notes, images, and PDFs on its own
Propose small note edits, new notes, and property changes for in-note review
Use Smart Connections semantic rankings or fall back to keyword search
Search the web through the provider's built-in search and cite sources
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0+. API keys are stored in per-device local storage rather than data.json to survive sync; the README warns local storage is unencrypted and recommends scoped keys with spend limits. Installable via BRAT; release builds carry artifact attestations. Editing notes, memory, and web access are all off by default; web search is billed per use by the provider.
motivation: The author built it around four constraints: it must work on a phone via plain HTTPS calls, avoid vendor lock-in with provider-neutral backends, reuse Smart Connections instead of competing with it, and treat a vault as more than markdown by searching images and PDFs.
problem: Other AI Obsidian plugins rely on local runtimes or MCP servers that don't work on phones, lock you to one provider, and ignore attachments like images and PDFs.

relations.evidence: It should reuse Smart Connections, not compete with it.

requires.name: Provider API key (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, or OpenRouter)

summary: AI chat plugin that searches your vault, opens notes, images and PDFs, and answers with tappable wikilinks, on desktop and mobile.
